The side entrance was closed in order that the queue would become longer.
The side entrance was closed for fear that the queue would become longer.
The side entrance was closed on condition that the queue became longer.
answer: The side entrance was closed with the result that the queue became longer.

rationales.The side entrance was closed on conditio: On condition that turns the consequence into a stipulation governing closure.
